_transfer_overrides_note: Global defaults applied to every Fusion FA bookTransfer / transferAsset call.  Per-row TARGET_LOCATION_ID / TARGET_EXPENSE_CCID from BIP still win.  Note: do NOT set conversion_rate_type globally — it is ledger-specific.  When unset the parameter is omitted, which is required for same-currency transfers and for ledgers that don't publish that rate type.
_transfer_overrides_by_book_note: Per-target-book overrides, keyed by destination book code (case-insensitive).  Required for cross-currency transfers because Oracle FA rejects an unknown conversion_rate_type and rejects an empty one when FX is needed.  Set conversion_rate_type to whatever the destination ledger publishes (commonly 'Corporate', 'Spot', 'User', or 'Daily').  Books not listed here transfer with the parameter omitted.
